title: The Day the Bicycles Grew Antlers
description: On the morning of the autumn homecoming ride, antlers sprout from every bicycle in town. A child finds the tallest pair on an old green bike.
alt: A child and adult crouch beside a green bicycle with branching antlers on its handlebars. More antlered bikes line a cobbled lane covered in autumn leaves.
pairing: An autumn homecoming ride × bicycles that sprout antlers
